_howto: One entry per resource. 'path' is either a file you placed in public/files/ (write it as /files/your-file.pdf) or a full https:// link (for example to an NM intranet page). 'tags' drive the topic filter. Delete the two example entries once you add real ones.

resources.title: Example: ELSO guidelines (external link)
resources.description: Public ELSO guideline index. External links open in a new tab.

resources.title: BronchSim: virtual bronchoscopy simulator
resources.description: Free browser-based bronchoscopy trainer built on a 3D airway from a real CT. Practice navigating to the lobar and segmental bronchi, with explore, quiz, and timed challenge modes. Nothing to install.

resources.title: MV-Ed Ventilator Simulator (VentCoach)
resources.description: Interactive ventilator simulator from The MV-Ed Project with VC, PC, PSV, and PRVC modes, live waveforms, ABGs, and alarms. Work through guided case-based lessons from basic settings to hypoxemia and extubation readiness, or run it freely.
